contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP C[--]VS[--] ; R/ CAESARVM NOSTR[ORVM]

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), Caesarum Nostrorum issue of 321-324, Reece period 16. Obverse description Bust laureate right. Obverse inscription: IMP C[--]VS[--]. Reverse description: Vow in wreath, central legend lost. Reverse inscription: CAESARVM NOSTR[ORVM]. Diameter: 18.2mm, Weight: 2.03gms, die axis: probably 12
